name: panel
description: A side pane with this session's directory and usage, subagents, GitHub PRs / issues / repos and links; /panel toggles it

showSession.title: Show session
showSession.description: Directory, model, context and usage at the top

showGit.title: Show GitHub
showGit.description: PRs, issues and repo links seen in this session

showLinks.title: Show links
showLinks.description: Other links seen in this session

width.title: Width
width.description: Columns the panel asks for when docked

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the panel when a session starts, unless /panel last closed it

visibleRows.title: Visible rows
visibleRows.description: Rows per section or tab before "+N more"

tabThreshold.title: Links tab threshold
tabThreshold.description: Links from one site needed to give that site its own tab

ghRefreshSeconds.title: GitHub refresh
ghRefreshSeconds.description: Seconds between gh checks of open PRs and issues; 0 checks each once

agentsKeep.title: Agents keep
agentsKeep.description: Minutes a finished agent keeps its own row (failed: 6x) before folding into the summary; 0 never folds

gitSort.title: GitHub order
gitSort.description: PRs and issues; attention: needs action first; recent: as seen; repo: grouped by repository

sessionLines.title: Session lines
sessionLines.description: Comma list, in order: dir (with git branch), model, context, 5h, week

sessionTheme.title: Session colors
sessionTheme.description: gruvbox; hud: claude-hud defaults; terminal: follows the Claude theme
